rulings.ruling: Ruling: model error; the candidate makes the counted-form answer necessary with a single Form 1095-A. i8962 p. 15, Column (b), "Enter the annual applicable SLCSP premium from Form 1095-A, line 33, column B. If you have more than one Form 1095-A, enter the amount as follows." With one form its column B is entered without a choice, and the project's (forms = 1, or b_counted) needs no answer then. Triage executable-triage-v2 (triage/f1095a.json; 1,228 fixtures, 500 generated returns seed 20261026, 40 partial bases, 1,113 partial records): 1,653 of 1,677 comparisons agree; kinds {"candidate-unknown": 24}; by return {"completed": {"candidate-unknown": 12}, "refused": {"candidate-unknown": 12}}. Every difference is candidate-unknown on partial records that withhold b_counted on a one-form return (bases classm.dependent.4.deepseek, classm.s3.2, classm.f8962.4, stage18.blind.p3, p7 and p15, returns completed), where the project shows true. Wherever b_counted is supplied the two agree. The BUG-0189 rewording of b_counted does not change this: the single-form branch of b_used never reads it.

Ruling: representation; i1095a p. 2, "Total the amounts on lines 21 through 32 and enter on line 33." The candidate sums its lines 21A to 32A, which are the project's twelve monthly helpers (a_jan to a_dec: the one monthly amount on the uniform route, the month's entry otherwise). The project takes 12 times the one monthly amount on the uniform route (D3) and the sum of the twelve entries otherwise; on the uniform route every month equals the one amount, so the totals are equal. Triage executable-triage-v2 (triage/f1095a.json; 1,228 fixtures, 500 generated returns seed 20261026, 40 partial bases, 1,113 partial records): 1,677 of 1,677 comparisons agree; kinds {}; by return {}. No difference on the sample, and none is possible from the derivation. Exact cents are kept under amb.2025.ptc_1095a_cents in both. Same ruling as round 1 (deepseek).

Ruling: representation; i1095a p. 2, "Total the amounts on lines 21 through 32 and enter on line 33." The candidate sums its lines 21B to 32B (the project's b_jan to b_dec, the corrected column B) and, as its note says, leaves the counting rule to f1095a.b_used rather than zeroing an uncounted form, which is the project's structure (f8962.line11b and lines 12(b) to 23(b) sum only forms with b_used true). On the uniform route 12 times the one monthly amount equals the sum of the months.
